provenance.description: Hand-written allusions in a preacher's words and sentences that are not Scripture, typed, never spoken. Used to compare allusion-matching options. 'allusions', 'notScripture', 'afterAName' and 'insideSermonPassage' were also used to choose thresholds; the three 'fresh*' lists were written afterwards and never tuned on. Expected values are [book, chapter] and list Gospel parallels. 'everydayStories' are he/she anecdotes that are not Scripture, some deliberately close to a Bible story; they were used to measure false suggestions once a Bible name is being remembered. One sentence was removed from 'notScripture' on review: it is Deuteronomy 28:13.
